description:
File: /home/mark/PROJECT/JMAP/crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs:161-233
Issue: handle_chat_query_changes is a ~70-line near-verbatim copy of the generic jmap_server::handlers::handle_query_changes, with the only behavioral difference being that filter and sort are hardcoded to None instead of parsed from args. This structural duplication means bug fixes or wire-format changes to the generic handler will not propagate here.
Fix: Either delegate to the generic handler (handle_query_changes::<Chat, B>(backend, args).await) once Chat implements QueryObject with its own Filter/Comparator, or document and isolate the intentional deviation (no filter/sort parsing) as a thin wrapper rather than a full copy.
title: handle_chat_query_changes duplicates generic handle_query_changes
